historical_reviews.v3_1: Wistron I2C defaults to BMC/platform-management ownership. ED-04 permits a conditional passive RIO inventory/status plan after the project maps endpoints, signal ownership, route and oracle.

original_test_intent: Validate management-I2C connectivity for the remote-I/O board and its expected controller/endpoints while proving that external inputs, outputs and control signals remain unchanged.
original_method: The owner supplies RIO board/controller identity, connector and external-signal ownership, BMC/mux route, passive identity/status registers and expected responses; the agent collects those reads with correlated I/O state and platform health.
manual_activity: The remote-I/O/control owner maps RIO_BD to physical and logical endpoints, declares a safe external-signal state, approves passive reads and provides independent recovery plus any separately specified physical stage.
required_inputs: Connector/port and external input/output ownership map
BMC/OOB controller, mux and I2C route
Expected management target addresses and identities
Explicit exclusions for output, relay, GPIO direction, reset and configuration writes
Expected endpoint state and response oracle
Independent console/control recovery and abort conditions
safety_requirements: Do not infer cable handling or continuity measurement from RIO_BD
Do not scan unknown buses or addresses
Do not write outputs, relays, GPIO direction, reset or configuration registers
Do not disturb safety or facility-control signals
Capture stable external-I/O state before and after
Stop on output transition, endpoint loss, controller reset, bus lock, BMC loss, power or thermal anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Verify RIO board, controller and endpoint identities
Validate signal ownership, safe state and passive-read allowlist
Perform no physical action or output/control write
engineer_actions: Bind RIO endpoints and external-signal ownership
Approve passive reads and safe I/O state
Define expected responses, aborts and recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command is provided. Current no-run behavior is safe, but an inferred physical continuity test is not the Master method; a passive logical plan is feasible only after endpoint and signal ownership are established.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved BMC/OOB interface to read only mapped RIO identity, input-status and health registers, with output/control paths explicitly excluded and external signals monitored before and after.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: RIO_BD, TBD procedure/criteria and two-minute planning metadata are retained; no endpoint, signal, bus, address, register or safe state is guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES RIO I2C PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Fingerprint RIO/controller/endpoint topology, capture baseline external signals, traverse the documented BMC mux path, read only passive identity/input/health state, compare with the project oracle, then prove outputs, endpoints, management and platform health are unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines conditional logical coverage without replacing the Master TBD fields or inventing a physical operation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Management reads cover the approved RIO control path; they do not prove cable/connector integrity or continuity, and no active output exercise is included.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong register can toggle external outputs or change GPIO direction, potentially affecting attached equipment or recovery access.

project_override_considerations: Projects must identify whether RIO means remote/facility I/O, rack I/O or another board function. Passive read coverage and any physical/electrical coverage remain separately stated; output exercise requires a different explicit plan.
expected_evidence: Before/after external inputs/outputs, BMC events and platform power/thermal health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master is incomplete but internally consistent. Physical continuity is derived history, not a contradictory source requirement.

blocked_analysis.analysis: RIO identity and passive management-status evidence can form a deterministic plan once endpoint and external-signal ownership are project-bound. Those missing bindings are readiness inputs under ED-04.

review_improvement: Replaces an unsupported manual-only interpretation with an external-signal-aware passive RIO plan and explicitly prevents output/GPIO mutations that a generic I2C probe could trigger.
independent_technical_reasoning: Remote-I/O management can expose both passive status and state-changing output registers. A correct test must know which endpoint and external signal each resource controls and must demonstrate no output transition. With a strict passive allowlist and safe-state monitoring the evidence is conditionally automatable; without them no probe is permitted.
